digest.component_or_area: CLI command hierarchy and bridge noun group
propositions: The bridge noun must be established with functional preview (read-only) and sync (mutating) subcommands without advertising unimplemented verbs or breaking legacy top-level commands
All existing legacy commands (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, rebar doctor) must remain fully functional with no change to persisted schema or MCP surface
The mode.py module's MODE_CAPS and Mode rank ladder must survive intact for MCP compatibility and gated_mode round-trip
Nested bridge subcommand dispatch must never fall through to top-level commands and must have explicit group/help/unknown-verb behavior
Documentation (user guide, CLI reference, release notes) must describe only the staged surface that ships (preview and sync) while preserving all legacy vocabulary
Callers cannot pass --mode or --filter-local-ids through the bridge foundation to override the read/write distinction enforced by preview and sync
